attr.title: Guitar Hero III (native)
attr.desc: A native player for Guitar Hero III's own PC data files, in Portuguese, with the game's own menus, venues, band and crowd in 3D: the career with its tiers, battles and encores unlocked like the game, records and stars, lead guitar or bass, four difficulties, hammer-ons, sustains and star power with the game's note-judging rules, song previews, configurable controls and options. Bring your own copy of the game's DATA folder.
attr.inst: Copy the game's DATA folder (at least PAK/, SONGS/, MUSIC/ and ZONES/) to ports/gh3/DATA/. See README.md.
